summary: Validated the Ashtech Pay Direct v1 official-10-countries refactor (CATALOG_VERSION=2026-08-06-v3-official10-cdf). 14 pytest cases + full frontend walk-through on /activation-ashtec. Backend catalog, initiate, admin diag/health, and frontend chips/operators/amounts all conform exactly to the official doc. CD (RD Congo) added correctly with CDF/12500. No API-key leak anywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate definition of async def _ashtec_enabled(db) in ashtec_activation.py (lines 160-163 and 215-220). Not a bug because both bodies are identical, but should be de-duplicated for hygiene.
ashtec_activation.py is 921 lines — >700 line threshold. Consider splitting: (a) catalog + config helpers, (b) initiate + otp + status polling, (c) webhook, (d) admin diag/health endpoints.

ashtec_activation.py:246 hardcodes fallback webhook URL 'https://spiloveure.com/api/webhooks/ashtec' when ASHTECPAY_WEBHOOK_URL env is missing — recommend failing fast in production instead of a magic domain.

ASHTECH_OPERATOR_MAP is declared but empty — if any operator display label differs from what Ashtech returns via 422, populate this table (e.g. RD Congo 'Airtel' vs 'Airtel Money'). Currently the display label is sent verbatim to /v1/collect.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend catalog v3 verified. /api/payments/ashtec/catalog is public and safe (no key leak). /api/admin/payments/ashtec/{diag,health} return only api_key prefix (8 chars + '…'). Initiate rejects unknown countries with 400. Frontend activation-ashtec displays exactly 10 chips with correct flags/currencies; selecting CD switches montant to '12\u202f500 CDF' and shows 5 CD operators; selecting TG shows '2\u202f500 XOF' with Flooz (Moov)/T-Money.
